name: Insight Blueprint
description: Hypothesis-driven data analysis workflow and catalog MCP server
longDescription:
Ships **10 skills** and **2 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (10): `analysis-design` (Guides Claude through creating analysis design documents for hypothesis-driven EDA), `analysis-framing` (Explores existing data and analyses to help frame a hypothesis), `analysis-journal` (Records reasoning steps during hypothesis-driven analysis as an Insight Journal), `analysis-reflection` (Guides structured reflection on an analysis design using its Insight Journal), `analysis-revision` (Guides structured revision of an analysis design based on review comments), `batch-analysis` (Overnight batch execution of queued analysis designs), `catalog-register` (Guides Claude through discovering data source schemas and registering them in the insight-blueprint data catalog), `data-lineage` (Track data transformation pipeline lineage in analysis notebooks/scripts), and 2 more
- **MCP servers** (2): `insight-blueprint`, `spec-workflow`

Installs with `claude plugin install insight-blueprint@claude-community` from `etoyama/insight-blueprint`.
